alert: AgentFlow: stuck case or workflow run

A.name: A
A.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS ts, countIf(name = 'orchestrator.advance_conversation' AND attributes_string['af.outcome'] = 'error') * 6 + greatest(countIf(name = 'workflow.advance_run' AND attributes_string['af.outcome'] = 'error') - 5, 0) AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name IN ('orchestrator.advance_conversation', 'workflow.advance_run') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

annotations.summary: Orchestrator conversation errors, or more than 5 workflow.advance_run errors in 15 minutes
annotations.description: Open the Orchestrator and Workflows & integrations dashboards, then Journeys with the case id or workflow run id.
